Package org.cibseven.bpm.engine.impl.bpmn.behavior

Interface AdHocSubProcessObserver

All Known Implementing Classes:
AgenticTurnTrigger
public interface AdHocSubProcessObserver
Told when a child of an ad hoc sub process ends or is removed, so that whatever decides what the scope starts next can act on it.

The scope's own behaviour calls it, so it is not a listener a caller can switch off: skipCustomListeners does not reach it. It is called once per performance of a direct child, whatever the child is -- an activity, a chain of activities, an embedded or nested ad hoc scope, a multi-instance body -- and never for what runs inside such a child. A fork inside a child, a parallel gateway in its flow, is not supported yet: it breaks the scope's execution tree (CIB7-2264). Not reported: children cancelled because the scope completes, is interrupted or is cancelled; a child whose inner flow meets the completion condition, whose path is gathered as the scope completes there; and a compensation handler of a child that runs after the scope has left. It runs in the transaction that ends or removes the child. Registered on the behaviour by a parse listener, so it is part of the deployed definition.

Migration: today the engine refuses to migrate a process instance while an ad hoc sub process in it is active, so no migration calls an observer. Should that change, a migration that drops a child of the scope, or moves one under another parent, reports it to childRemoved(org.cibseven.bpm.engine.impl.pvm.delegate.ActivityExecution, org.cibseven.bpm.engine.impl.pvm.delegate.ActivityExecution) before the child's execution under the scope is removed. The scope execution may then still reference the source definition, through its process definition or its activity, so what an observer creates from it, such as a job, may belong to the source definition; the migration does not move it. Whether the source's or the target's observers are called depends on how far the migration has got.

  • Method Details

    • childEnded

      void childEnded(ActivityExecution scopeExecution, ActivityExecution endedExecution)
      A child ended, and its result, if the scope gathers, is already in the collection. Called before the scope consults its completion condition and before the ended child is removed.

    • childRemoved

      void childRemoved(ActivityExecution scopeExecution, ActivityExecution removedExecution)
      A child was removed without ending: cancelled by a process instance modification, or dropped or moved by a migration (see above). After a modification the child's work has already been cancelled: removedExecution has ended, is no longer among the scope's children, and its variables are gone. Its id and its activity are still there, which tells which child it was; read nothing else from it, and create nothing on it. A modification that cancels the scope's only child cancels the scope with it, and nothing is reported.
